elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "amounts paid or payable by AbbVie to Harpoon under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — anchored to the event, not to the claim

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000 floor, with cap set at the greater of the two limbs
elements.evidence: "the greater of (a) ... and (b) One Million United States Dollars (US$1,000,000)"
"NEITHER PARTY NOR ANY OF ITS AFFILIATES SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: "(B) FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS UNDER [ARTICLE 9 OR SECTION 5.8]" made uncapped by "clauses (A) through (D) ... for which liability is not capped"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: Carve-outs list only "FRAUD, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE", "[ARTICLE 9 OR SECTION 5.8]", "[***]" and indemnification; no data protection or security obligation is named
"(D) TO THE EXTENT ANY SUCH DAMAGES ARE REQUIRED TO BE PAID TO A THIRD PARTY AS PART OF A CLAIM FOR WHICH A PARTY PROVIDES INDEMNIFICATION UNDER THIS ARTICLE 11", excepted from the cap
"(A) FOR FRAUD, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: No IP-infringement carve-out appears in clauses (A)–(D) or in the inserted "Except for the matters described in clauses (A) through (D)"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "AbbVie's obligation to pay amounts that have become due under Article 6 shall not constitute damages" — limited to Article 6 amounts already due, not Customer's payment obligations generally
"each Party's total aggregate liability ... shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by AbbVie to Harpoon ... in the twelve (12) months"
clause "(D) ... INDEMNIFICATION UNDER THIS ARTICLE 11" excluded from the cap
"(B) FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS UNDER [ARTICLE 9 ...]"

elements.element: Carve-out for gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "(A) FOR FRAUD, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE"

reasons: The locked target is preferred, but the fee limb is anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim" rather than the required "12 months preceding the claim"; change the anchor to the claim.
No uncapped carve-out for data protection and security obligations, and none for infringement of the other Party's intellectual property; add both to the excepted matters.
The payment-obligation savings language is too narrow: it covers only "amounts that have become due under Article 6" rather than Customer's payment obligations (all amounts due) generally.

The insertion is otherwise concise, mutual, cross-references the existing (A)–(D) carve-outs as uncapped, includes the USD 1,000,000 limb, and leaves the indirect-damages waiver and all other terms intact, so it comfortably clears the fallback (mutual 12-months'-fees cap with indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct carve-outs).
